info.title: HomeResult Inference API
info.description: API for predicting football match outcomes using a trained machine learning model.

get.description: Returns a welcome message and the expected feature columns for predictions. Useful for checking if the API is running.

post.description: Get a prediction for a football match outcome based on input features (such as home and away team names). Returns the predicted class and probabilities.

200.description: The predicted outcome and class probabilities.

features.title: Features
features.description: Key-value map of feature columns matching the training data. Example: { 'home': 'TeamA', 'away': 'TeamB' }
